messages.content: 今天美國的黃金價格是多少？

function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Face_Value.description: The face value of the bond. This is a float type value.

Coupon_rate.description: The coupon rate of the bond. This is a float type value.

Required_return.description: The required rate of return on the bond. This is a float type value.

maturity_years.description: The number of years to maturity of the bond.

message.content:
抱歉，我無法即時查詢最新市場數據。建議您可以參考以下可靠來源來取得今日美國黃金（或全球黃金）價格：

| 資料來源 | 網站 / 平台 |
|----------|-------------|
| Bloomberg | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets |
| Reuters | https://www.reuters.com/finance/commodities/gold |
| Kitco (專門報導貴重金屬) | https://www.kitco.com |
| 美國商品期貨交易所 (CME) – 黃金合約行情 | https://www.cmegroup.com/trading/metals/precious.html |

這些網站通常會在首頁顯示「Spot Gold」或「Gold Futures」等實時價位，並提供歷史走勢圖表與分析工具。若需要更精確、個別時間點的成交價，也可透過證券商或投資平台查看其交易系統中的行情資訊。

如果您想要快速獲得近似值，可留意大多數金融新聞頻道每天上午10–11點左右公布一次「當日收盤價」，但請注意不同資料源可能因計算方式略有差異。
message.reasoning:
The user asks "今天美國的黃金價格是多少?" which means "What is today's gold price in America?". We need current data; we don't have real-time capability. According to policy, if we cannot provide up-to-date info, we should say we can't fetch it or suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, etc.

We can also mention typical range but not exact. So respond with apology and suggestion.
